The line is paused. Your place is still saved.

SmartQueue can show the app shell offline, but live queue numbers need a connection. Reconnect to see updated positions and notifications.

What still works offline

  • Pages you already opened may load from your device.
  • The last queue snapshot stays visible until a new one arrives.
  • Do not rely on an offline ticket at the counter. Ask staff to check the central queue.
